# {title} — execution evidence

## Scope, snapshot and execution

Record LIGHT/FULL and why, current phase/next step, resolved base/head and dirty/untracked
scope. Label delegated roles or sequential multi-pass honestly. The agent maintains this
file; the owner supplies goals/constraints rather than bookkeeping.

## PROSPECT and test data

Facts with receipts, assumptions, role instruments, fixture sources and environment gaps.
Record ADEQUATE/PARTIAL/BLOCKED with each requirement/case/source and closing action.
Use docs/forge/references/test-data-protocol.md and conditional capture guidance.

## SURVEY and decisions

User answers, AGENT defaults, and links to ADRs.

## Implementation and requirement coverage

Link the design and map each requirement to implementation and behavioral assertions.

## Verification runs

Record exact commands, environment, exit codes, and outcomes. Distinguish application,
integration, E2E, and framework validation. Never mark an unrun command as passing.

## ASSAY findings and dispositions

Label independent review or self-review. Link the code_review synthesis and forge audit
receipts. Include HONEST/WEAK/LYING/DEAD test counts against the actual audited denominator,
findings/dispositions, reruns and remaining blockers. If no findings, state inspected
scope and limitations rather than inventing an all-green audit.

## Delivery

PR URL, CI results, owner demo instructions, remaining limitations, and resume notes.
